purpose: Generated visual references; live game sprites unchanged.
limitations: Illustrative generated views, not dimensionally validated orthographic drawings. Sprite is enlarged pixel-style art; exact 120px height, 30–35 color palette and uniform pixel grid unverified.
model_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw an orthographic four-view model sheet of the EXACT HIPPOPOTAMUS MECH in the attached current eight-view sprite sheet. Input image is the authoritative design reference. Spacious 2x2 grid: top left TRUE SIDE elevation facing RIGHT, top right TRUE FRONT elevation, bottom left TRUE BACK elevation, bottom right orthographic front-right THREE-QUARTER view. SAME SCALE and same standing height throughout, neutral planted four-foot pose. Technical elevations with level camera, no perspective, no raised camera in the side/front/back; three-quarter uses parallel projection. Flat even lighting, clean cel shading with only 2–3 tones per material, dark colored seam lines between armor plates, flat uniform neutral grey background, no gradients, no text or logos.

Keep this current design exactly: wide low very heavy barrel-bodied quadruped, short thick sturdy legs, large blunt broad rectangular hippo muzzle projecting forward low near ground. Segmented dusty mauve/plum-purple armor shell with pale lavender lit facets and deep purple seams, graphite grey feet and understructure, grey exposed leg rings/connectors. Cream IVORY teeth/tusks flanking the head, two ivory fittings on top of head as in reference, big ivory segmented toe caps on each foot. Tiny flat CYAN rectangular eyes and cyan side sensors. Large grey circular leg/shoulder/hip hubs with COPPER/bronze inner rims and dark centers, small copper-orange hardware accents and piping under side armor. Purple ribbed vent stacks just behind head. Preserve the low steel-grey rectangular BOX MODULE on the spine and the other low grey/copper back fittings exactly in their reference positions; do not turn into a tall turret, tank cannon or new weapon. Short small dark segmented tail behind, same back/rear geometry from the reference. Match reference armor panel boundaries, hip/shoulder construction, foot shapes and all visible asymmetries. No rounded organic skin or fur, no giant ears, no extra limbs, no redesigned horns or weapons. Cyan eyes/sensors are flat color with NO glow or bloom. This is a faithful mechanical model sheet, not a different hippo.
sprite_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE highly polished game battle sprite of the EXACT HIPPOPOTAMUS MECH in the attached eight-view current sprite sheet, in the style of GBA Zoids Legacy battle sprites. Image 1 is the sole shape and hardware reference. Full-body machine facing RIGHT, camera approximately 18 degrees above ground and turned 20 degrees toward viewer from side profile. Low wide heavy quadruped in planted battle stance, all four short legs and entire small tail present, generous margins. Flat uniform neutral medium grey background, no vignette, ONE thin straight VIOLET ground line beneath its feet. No other views, text, labels, logos, borders or scenery.

Authentic deliberate pixel art, native design about 120 logical pixels tall, presented enlarged nearest-neighbor with crisp consistent pixel clusters. Target 30–35 colors in long material ramps, upper-left light, readable broad plate faces, tiny controlled edge glints and orderly mechanical details. Outline each part with a darker shade of its own material color, NEVER pure black. No antialiasing, blur, painterly texture, photorealism, smooth 3D rendering or bloom.

Preserve this exact current hippo: wide low barrel body covered with segmented mauve/plum PURPLE armor, pale lavender highlights and deep violet seams; a very broad blunt rectangular hippo muzzle carried low, purple layered jaw, tiny flat CYAN eyes and cyan body sensors. IVORY tusks beside head, the two cream fittings atop head in the reference, large blocky ivory toe caps on dark graphite feet. Four short thick pillar-like purple armored legs, exposed grey steel rings/connectors and large grey circular joint hubs with COPPER/bronze rims and dark centers, smaller copper fittings and piping along the sides. Tall purple ribbed vents directly behind head. Low rectangular grey box hardware on spine and other low grey/copper back fittings exactly where shown, no invented tall turret or large tank gun. Tiny dark segmented tail with purple tip, no long new tail. Preserve panel boundaries, shoulder/hip construction and asymmetries. No fur, skin, organic wrinkles, added ears, extra limbs, additional horns or redesign. Cyan is a flat pixel accent, no emitted glow, aura, bloom or eye light spill. Translate the existing machine faithfully into a refined handheld-game pixel-art sprite reference.
